description: Capability set for the windows that load the Sphinx renderer. The renderer talks to the sidecar only through ipc_invoke/ipc_send, which are additionally gated by the generated allowlist in src-tauri/src/ipc/allowlist.rs. No filesystem, shell or dialog permission is granted to the webview: those capabilities live in Rust and are reachable only through the sidecar's RPC methods. External windows (Epic/Steam auth) are deliberately absent: they load provider pages and must not reach Sphinx IPC.
